newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady on overnight crude gains.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady on overnight crude gains.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Tuesday held steady from Monday, borrowing support from overnight crude gains, traders.

Buyers were still at a standoff as offers were too high, traders said. A broker said prices in Taiwan were very competitive and some shipowners were considering bunkering there instead. A shipowner said prices in the U.S. were also strong on Monday night's crude gains.
Bunker 380-cst prices were quoted at $121-$122 per tonne and 180-cst at $125-$127 per tonne. MDO and gasoil were steady, quoted at $233 and $240-$246 respectively. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3082)
